text:
marta: Heads-up — ruby-sampleapp CI is failing on one of the matrix jobs (Ruby 3.2) after some bundler changes. Reproduced locally with `bundle install`. Error snippet below. cc @tom @ashwin

marta: ```
Fetching gem metadata from https://rubygems.org/
Your bundle is locked to rack (2.2.4) but that version could not be found in any of the sources
In snapshot (Gemfile.lock):
  rack (= 2.2.4)
In Gemfile:
  graphql-client (~> 1.7) depends on rack (~> 3.0)

Bundler could not find compatible versions for gem "rack"
  Run `bundle update rack` to try to resolve the conflict
```

tom: Ugh. Looks like `graphql-client` bumped a peer dep. Did we pin the lockfile anywhere?

ashwin: Which PR or branch hit this? CI matrix only fails for 3.2 you said?

marta: Yeah. Local repro and CI job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/actions/runs/1234567890. The change is in a vendor PR but not lockfile: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/342 (deps).

tom: Two quick options: pin `BUNDLER_VERSION` in the CI to the one we use in dev (2.4.x) or update the lockfile to resolve the new constraint.

ashwin: Prefer updating lockfile if upstream is safe. If it's a major bump (rack 3.x) we might need small app code changes.

marta: I tried `bundle update graphql-client` locally — tests pass, but lockfile changes are non-trivial. Opening a small PR with lockfile regen now so CI can run full matrix.

ci-bot: :gear: Rerun requested by marta — requeueing job 3245.

devex-oncall: If you open a PR with just the lockfile change, ping me. I can do a quick smoke on a Dedicated node and greenlet a backport if needed.

marta: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/355 — includes `bundle lock` update and a note about bundler version. Running `rake smoke` locally.

tom: :eyes: I'll watch checks. If the matrix still fails, I'll add a short CI tweak to force `BUNDLER_VERSION=2.4.13` so we don't block releases.

ashwin: Also might be worth adding one-line to CONTRIBUTING.md: preferred bundler version and how to regen lockfile. Small devex win.

marta: Good call — added to PR description that I'll follow up with a docs PR.

tom: :shipit: assuming green. Thanks for the quick turnaround!
